question: Will Bitcoin reach $67,500 in July?
resolution_criteria:
This market will immediately resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for BTC/USDT during the month specified in the title (from 00:00 AM ET on the first day to 11:59 PM ET on the last), has a final High price equal to or greater than the price specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the BTC/USDT High prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BTC_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance BTC/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.
research:
I couldn't confirm Binance's exact BTC/USDT July high, but no source I found dated on or before July 17 shows BTC near $67,500 this month. The highest reported level is about $65,100 to $66,000, on July 15. At forecast close BTC was around $63,000 to $64,000, so it needs a further rise of about 5 to 7% by July 31.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-17: I tried to pull Binance BTC/USDT daily candles through the Binance API, but the proxy refused the connection. Pages from CoinDesk, Fool, crypto.news, Bitcoin Foundation and StartupHub also failed to load, so the figures below come from search-result summaries.
- 2026-07-17: Fortune reported BTC at about $62,942 at 6:00 AM ET, down $1,113 from the morning before. That is after the forecast closed at 04:22 UTC (00:22 ET), but on the cutoff date. YCharts lists about $63,792 for July 17 (midnight UTC). [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-17-2026/), [YCharts](https://ycharts.com/indicators/bitcoin_price)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing so far settles the question. The highest July print I found is on July 15, and two sources disagree on its size:
  - Bitcoin Foundation: BTC briefly topped $65,000 for the first time since June 22, with a high of about $65,100. [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/bitcoin/btc-price-july-15/)
  - PrimeXBT: price was rejected near $66,000 on July 15, and every attempt higher this month has stalled in that zone. [PrimeXBT](https://primexbt.com/market-research/bitcoin-presses-the-resistance-that-has-capped-it-all-month-as-etf-inflows-return-these-are-the-key-levels-to-watch/)
- 2026-07-01: The month opened near $58,278, so the low so far is about $58,000 to $58,300. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-01-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-16: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $79M net (IBIT about $33M). That made five straight inflow sessions worth about $727M. [TFTC](https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/july-2026), [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/crypto-etfs-news/btc-price-bitcoin-etfs/)
- 2026-07-16: BTC was about $64,055 at 5:45 AM ET, roughly 46% below a year earlier. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-16-2026/)
- 2026-07-15: A softer US CPI report (reported as -0.4% month on month, 3.5% year on year) set off a rally, and BTC neared or briefly topped $65,000. CoinDesk said the rally later cooled, with oil prices clouding the outlook. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/07/15/crypto-market-today-july-15-bitcoin-nears-usd65-000-as-crypto-rallies-on-softer-inflation-data/), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/07/15/bitcoin-rally-cools-as-investors-digest-inflation-data-oil-clouds-outlook)
- 2026-07-13: Renewed US-Iran hostilities pushed BTC lower, though ETF flows still showed demand. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/07/13/resurgent-u-s-iran-hostilities-send-bitcoin-lower-even-as-etf-flows-show-demand)
- 2026-07-06 and 2026-07-10: Morning prices were about $61,935 and $64,341. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-10-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- Late June 2026: BTC hit a 21-month low near $58,000 (about June 25). June closed at about $58,559, down roughly 20% for the month, and spot ETFs saw about $4B of outflows, reported as the worst month on record. [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/learn/bitcoin-price-predictions-expert-forecasts), [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/price-bitcoin-june-2026)
- One source says BTC has been capped near $66,000 for about 50 days. The last trades above $66,000 were around mid-June (June 17), and May 31 was near $74,000. [99Bitcoins](https://99bitcoins.com/news/presales/btc-usd-65k-resistance-etf-inflows/)
- The gap to cover is $67,500 against about $63,000 to $64,000, or roughly +5.5 to 7% in about 14.5 days. So far in July, BTC has ranged about 12% from low to high ($58.3k to $65.1-66k). A two-week move of 5 to 7% in BTC is common, but $67,500 sits above resistance that has held for weeks.
- I could not find implied volatility (DVOL) figures for this period.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs a market called "What price will Bitcoin hit in July?". StartupHub write-ups (undated in the results) said $67,500 was the most-traded strike, at about 61.5% in one piece and 78.5% in another. Those odds look high next to the price data, may come from early July or another snapshot, and I could not verify them. [StartupHub](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/polymarket-bets-on-bitcoin-s-july-2026-trajectory), [StartupHub 2](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/bitcoin-price-bets-july-2026)
- The same coverage put downside strikes at about 3.1% for $57,500 and 2.1% for $55,000.
- I could not get Polymarket's live price for the $67,500 strike as of July 17, or any matching Kalshi or Manifold prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-07-28/29: the FOMC meeting, the main scheduled macro catalyst. The 2026 calendar puts the July meeting on these dates. [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-price-prediction-july-2026-fed-decides/)
- Ongoing: whether the ETF inflow streak continues, US-Iran geopolitics and oil prices, and whether BTC can break the $66,000 resistance.
- 2026-07-31 11:59 PM ET: the window closes.
